column2: Found in 2020 by a machine-learning model that screened thousands of molecules for ones that kill bacteria. Its discoverers named it after HAL 9000, the computer in 2001: A Space Odyssey.

A red dye from 1932 and the first commercial drug to fight bacterial infections, years before penicillin was in use. Gerhard Domagk won the Nobel Prize for it, but the Nazi government made him turn it down.
